ei.subject: 수능특강Light

fullPassage: Research has shown that older adults may have a different view of health from that of professionals, research scientists, and policymakers. Professionals can emphasise the problems and limitations that occur due to ageing, frequently focusing on negatively phrased topics such as disability, disease, loneliness, overweight, and falls. By contrast, older people have been shown to focus more on supportive social environments, their ability to use resources and manage restrictions, adaptation, meaningfulness, and connectedness. Even though ageing and health describe a multifaceted relationship, historically this has been addressed through the creation and use of biomedical models of stimulus and outcome results. It is without dispute that a biomedical approach underlies many of the gains in public health during the twentieth century and indeed continues to play an important role in many of the health-science advances in the twenty-first century. However, debates around ageing and health have increasingly been expanded to include broader definitions regarding the contributors to health. Definitions of health have been called for, in line with the WHO vision of health as ‘a state of optimal physical, mental, and social well-being, and not merely the absence of disease and infirmity’.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 노화와 건강이 '다면적인 관계(a multifaceted relationship)'를 나타낸다는 문맥.

✅ ① a multifaceted relationship(다면적인 관계): 원문. 이후 의생물학적 모델(historically)과 확장된 정의(However) 양쪽 공존하는 다면성 ←정답
❌ ② an insignificant distinction(무의미한 차이): 이후 논의 자체 성립 불가
❌ ③ a straightforward correlation(단순한 상관관계): 의생물학적 접근 + WHO 정의 등 복합적 시각 제시하므로 '단순'은 부적절
❌ ④ an unresolvable conflict(해결 불가 갈등): 갈등이 아닌 다양한 관점 공존 서술
det.tip: Even though~historically~However 전환 구조에서 '다면적' 단서를 찾으세요.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: WHO 건강 정의: '단지 질병과 허약함의 부재가 아닌' 최적 안녕 상태.
det.analysis:
✅ ① not merely the absence of disease and infirmity: WHO 정의 원문. 건강 = 최적 안녕이며 '단지 질병 부재만이 아님' ←정답
❌ ② primarily defined by physical fitness alone: WHO는 physical + mental + social 세 가지 포괄. 'alone'은 축소
❌ ③ only achievable through biomedical intervention: However 이후 더 넓은 정의로 확장하는 맥락과 모순
❌ ④ independent of social and mental factors: WHO 정의 핵심이 'physical, mental, and social well-being' 통합
det.tip: 'not merely ~' = '단지 ~만이 아니라'. WHO 건강 정의의 핵심.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 의생물학적 접근이 20세기 공중 보건 성과의 근간이라는 서술 일치.

❌ ① 노인이 부정적 주제에 초점: 본문상 전문가(Professionals)가 부정적 주제에 집중. 주체 뒤바뀜
❌ ② 전문가가 적응·연결에 주목: 노인(older people)이 adaptation, connectedness에 집중. 전문가 아님
✅ ③ 'a biomedical approach underlies many of the gains in public health during the twentieth century' 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ 논의 미시작: 'have increasingly been expanded' 이미 확장 중. 정반대
